props.label: Who you are dealing with
props.heading: Hello, I am Utsav Meshram
props.body:
I am a Sales Executive at Tapify, working with businesses across Nagpur.

Most people I meet are still carrying paper cards that get thrown away, or they have reprinted a whole box because one number changed. Tapify fixes both: one card that never goes out of date, and a profile you can change any time from your phone.

The fastest way to understand it is to hold one. Message me and I will come to your shop, tap a card on your own phone, and you can decide from there. There is no charge for the demo and no obligation after it.

After you buy, you keep messaging me directly — not a call centre.

props.label: Before you ask
props.heading: The questions I get every week

items.q: Does the person I tap need the app?
items.a: No. Nothing is installed on either phone. The card opens your profile in their normal browser, and a QR code on the back covers any phone without NFC.

items.q: What if I change my phone number later?
items.a: You update it once on your profile and every card you have already handed out shows the new number. Nothing needs reprinting.

items.q: Will it survive my pocket and the rain?
items.a: The card is 100 percent waterproof and built to be carried daily. There is no battery and nothing to charge.

items.q: Can I get my logo and brand colours on it?
items.a: Yes. Cards are custom printed with your logo and colours, and your digital profile is styled to match.

items.q: What does it cost for a whole team?
items.a: Bulk pricing starts at ten cards: 10 percent off for 10–49, 15 percent for 50–99, and 20 percent for 100 or more. Message for an exact quote for your team size.

items.q: I lost my card. What now?
items.a: A replacement is ₹1,499 and is issued against your existing profile, so all your links and details carry over.

items.q: How does the Google Review stand help me?
items.a: It sits on your counter and takes a customer straight to your review page in one tap. Review count and rating are among the strongest signals for where you appear in local search results.

props.heading: Not sure which one fits your business?
props.sub: Tell me what you do and how many people need cards. I will tell you what I would order.

seo.title: Why Tapify Instead of Paper Cards | Utsav Meshram
seo.description: Why businesses in Nagpur are switching from printed visiting cards to Tapify NFC smart cards — no reprinting, instant sharing, more Google reviews.

props.label: The problem
props.heading: Paper cards are thrown away. Yours should not be.
props.body:
A printed card has two problems. Most of them end up in a bin within a day, and the moment one detail changes — a number, an address, a new Instagram — the whole box is wasted.

A Tapify card is handed over, tapped, and your details are saved on their phone before you have finished the sentence. Nothing to install, nothing to scan if the phone supports NFC, and a QR code on the back for the ones that do not.

And because your details live on a profile rather than on the card, you change them once and every card already in circulation updates itself.
